notes: The source is a north-up rectangular map, so source x maps only to Web Mercator x and source y maps only to Web Mercator y. Controls use road centreline intersections checked against the source raster and OpenStreetMap. This deliberately forbids the perspective distortion produced by the former exact four-point projective fit. The initial 0.2% horizontal contraction is followed by the author's reviewed live visual calibration, preserving the west and north edges while applying the final scale and position correction.
